decisions.title: Living Momentum OS v1 product concept lock
decisions.decision: AIIMIN v1 product concept is Living Momentum OS: Intent Capture + Calm Contextual Today + Memory/Timeline compound, with Family/Finance/Documents as trusted pillars and AI as mixed-initiative coach — never the home shell.
decisions.reason: Studio merge of three surviving concepts; one-year memory test; rejects Notion/Linear/widget/chat-home shapes.

sections: Step 4 — Merge → AIIMIN v1: Living Momentum OS — Definition
evidence.quote: Living Momentum OS = Intent Capture + Calm Contextual Today + Memory/Timeline compound, with Family/Finance/Documents as trusted pillars and AI as mixed-initiative coach — never the home shell.
AIIMIN v1 (this studio) is Living Momentum OS

decisions.implementation_impact: Feature intake must justify fit inside Living Momentum OS. Chat-as-home, Tasks/Projects primary, and widget-dashboard homes are out of canon.

decisions.title: Phone primary shell — Today | Knowledge | Capture FAB | Timeline | More
decisions.decision: Android-first phone primary shell is a bottom bar with four destinations plus center Capture FAB: Today, Knowledge, Timeline, More. Drawer may exist as optional power jump list; it must not create a second competing primary nav system.
decisions.reason: Studio IA lock and Android mapping migration target. Closes nav-primacy ambiguity for phone companion.

evidence.quote: Today | Knowledge | Capture FAB | Timeline | More
Android bottom bar: 4 destinations + center FAB.

decisions.implementation_impact: Replace native Home/Journal/Notes/Vault/More with Studio shell (or equivalent destinations). Founder must ratify against GOV-097 free-pin masthead (REC-077).

decisions.title: Surface one-job law — every surface declares exactly one job
decisions.decision: Every primary and secondary surface declares exactly one job. Canonical Studio jobs: Today=Act on this day; Knowledge=Capture and revise personal memory; Documents=Store and retrieve files/vault docs; Family=Shared care + private vault trust; Finance=Log and see money truth; Timeline=Remember what happened; AI=Ask/review/act with confidence chips; Search=Recall across the graph; Settings=Control system safely; Profile=Identity + honest progress; Onboarding=Three beats to first capture; Auth=Trust entry.
decisions.reason: Prevents everything-pages and competing personalities per screen.

evidence.quote: Today | Act on this day
Settings | Control system safely

decisions.implementation_impact: Page Blueprint / PR reviews reject multi-job dumps. New surfaces must publish one-job sentence before ship.

decisions.title: Refuse Tasks tab, Projects board, and widget dashboard as primary IA
decisions.decision: AIIMIN must not ship Tasks as a primary tab, Projects board as primary navigation, or a Living Dashboard of random widgets as the home. Goals may exist as labeled entities (Search/Goals) without a Projects-board primary world.
decisions.reason: Studio kill list + CPO critique — productivity-category death path.

evidence.quote: No Tasks tab as primary
No Projects board as primary
No Dashboard of random widgets
Ship Tasks/Projects primary tabs on Android — violates Living Momentum.

decisions.implementation_impact: Deny primary-nav proposals for Tasks/Projects/widget home. Goals labeling OK under Search/recall (see REC-084).

decisions.title: First-run flow — Splash → Onboarding ≤3 beats → Auth → App Shell
decisions.decision: Canonical first-run sequence is Splash → Onboarding (exactly three beats: Capture once, One graph, Honest mirror) → Auth → App Shell. Skip may exist on the last beat into Auth. Onboarding must not become infinite customization.
decisions.reason: Principal UX critique: ≤3 beats to first capture; NN bans infinite customization onboarding.

evidence.quote: Splash → Onboarding (3 beats) → Auth → App

Onboarding must be ≤3 beats to first capture.

decisions.implementation_impact: Cut Welcome/onboarding to three doctrinal beats. No multi-screen preference buffet before first capture path.

decisions.title: More is honest overflow — pillars and meta under More on phone
decisions.decision: On phone, More is the honest overflow destination containing Family, Finance, Documents, AI, Search, Settings, and Profile. Family/Finance/Documents are trusted pillars of Living Momentum OS but are not phone bottom-bar peers. Settings remains penalty-box; no daily capture actions live only in Settings.
decisions.reason: Studio More bag + GOV-100 Settings law + Living Momentum pillars.

evidence.quote: More | Family, Finance, Documents, AI, Search, Settings, Profile

decisions.implementation_impact: Phone More must list the seven overflow surfaces. Tablet Finance elevation is separate ADR (REC-080) — does not silently rewrite phone More.

decisions.title: Six page hierarchy layers — System / Day / Memory / Pillars / Intelligence / Account
decisions.decision: Product page hierarchy is ordered in six layers: (1) System — Splash, Onboarding, Auth; (2) Day — Today; (3) Memory — Knowledge, Timeline, Search; (4) Pillars — Family, Finance, Documents; (5) Intelligence — AI; (6) Account — Profile, Settings. New screens must declare which layer they belong to.
decisions.reason: Studio system design hierarchy — prevents orphan screens and wrong-layer chrome.

evidence.quote: 1. System — Splash, Onboarding, Auth
2. Day — Today
3. Memory — Knowledge, Timeline, Search

decisions.implementation_impact: Screen inventory and blueprints must tag layer 1–6. Mis-layered proposals fail intake (with GOV-103).

decisions.title: Global Capture FAB sheet is primary capture path
decisions.decision: A global Capture FAB opens a capture sheet that is the primary daily capture path. One utterance routes to habit / journal / finance / note / event with inference confirmation chips. Median daily interaction compression targets the capture sheet as the taught primary path — not deep-link tourism through every pillar.
decisions.reason: Studio interaction law + compression doctrine + Intent Capture OS survivor.

evidence.quote: Capture | FAB → sheet → chips confirm inference

decisions.implementation_impact: Native must ship global FAB + sheet routing. Capture must not require opening each pillar first. Aligns with GOV-127 Needs Discussion — Studio supplies concrete shell answer.
